name: Minor
description: Something is out of specification and the plant can work through it in the normal course of the shift. This is what a recorded check outside its limits opens, and what an SPC rule other than rule 1 opens.

name: Major
description: Something is out of specification badly enough that somebody should look at it now rather than at the end of the shift. This is what SPC rule 1 - a point beyond three sigma - opens.
